characters.name: Oracle
characters.description: An ancient, hooded seer whose crystal orb glows and drifts as she speaks.
characters.title: The Wandering Oracle
characters.sample_line: Gather close, dear hosts. The candles are lit and the doors are bolted, yet one among you carries a secret that does not wish to be found. Listen well, for the Veil speaks only once.

characters.name: Queen
characters.description: A poised sovereign in an emerald gown and a gem-set crown, sceptre in hand and every word a decree.
characters.title: The Iron Matron
characters.sample_line: Stand straight when you address the crown. This house has survived wars, scandals and three disastrous Christmas dinners. It will survive tonight, though perhaps not all of you will.

characters.name: Knight
characters.description: A helmed guardian in a deep red tabard, visor raised, sword held upright and ready.
characters.title: The Stalwart
characters.sample_line: I have sworn to guard this hall until the final clue is spoken. No blade, no bribe and no suspiciously generous slice of cake shall move me from my post.

characters.name: Detective
characters.description: A hard-boiled noir gumshoe in a fedora and trench coat, pipe in hand.
characters.title: The Quiet Watcher
characters.sample_line: I notice the mud upon your boots, the ink upon your cuff, the pause before your answer. Say nothing, if you like. Your silence is already telling me plenty.

characters.name: Tavern Storyteller
characters.description: A weathered traveller with an eye patch and a scruffy grey beard, lantern in hand for tales told by its flickering light.
characters.title: The Tavern Bard
characters.sample_line: Pull up a stool and fill your tankard, friend. The tale I am about to tell is mostly true, partly legend and entirely worth a second round.

characters.name: Magician
characters.description: A charismatic stage showman in top hat and tails, wand poised for the next flourish.
characters.title: The Showman
characters.sample_line: Ladies and gentlemen, keep your eyes on the card! What was here is gone, what was gone returns, and somewhere in this very room a culprit hides in plain sight!

characters.name: Jester
characters.description: A mischievous harlequin in a two-pointed bell hat, tumbling wit and diamond-tunic flair into every performance.
characters.title: The Songbird Jester
characters.sample_line: Oh yes it is! Oh no it is not! Hush your heckling, royal rabble. The Jester sees every trick, every lie and every stolen sausage roll.

characters.name: Wizard
characters.description: An archmage in a tall purple hat, casting gentle sparkles from a well-worn wand while he speaks.
characters.title: The Wizard
characters.sample_line: The stars have shifted, the runes are restless, and my tea has gone cold. Something wicked this way wanders, hosts. Do mind the carpet.

characters.name: King
characters.description: A regal monarch with a full white beard and an ermine-trimmed royal-blue robe, sovereign's orb resting in his palm.
characters.title: The King
characters.sample_line: By royal decree, no guest shall leave this feast until the truth is served. Pass the gravy, and prepare your alibis.
